spec.title: theia PROP-006: What the type does not provide, and what a product supplies

status.comment: the absences of the theia type, each an honest answer to a contract question; facts 09, 11

facts.THEIA-NO-BRAND-IMAGES: No icon target table exists upstream, so `brand-images` is not declared and `imageset` refuses. A product's icons are files of its application directory (splash screen `resources/theia-logo.svg` in the example, the Electron icon of the product's packager) - resource files of the delta.
facts.THEIA-NO-RUNTIME-LIBRARY: `runtime-library` is not declared in the first version: the feature-flag runtime of the tool is a VS Code library (`runtime-vscode`), and a Theia equivalent would bind through inversify and Theia preferences. It is written when a product needs it, as `runtime-theia`, from the same runtime specification.
facts.THEIA-NO-GEN-BRAND: `gen brand` is not declared: identity is a manifest key (PROP-003 `THEIA-IDENTITY-FUNNEL`), not a string funnel. `gen feature` is provided: the skeleton is an own container module with a preference-backed flag, in the own package.
facts.THEIA-PRODUCT-SUPPLIES: A product of this type supplies in its own delta: the application directory (manifest, resources, packager configuration), the own package, its licence header policy for lint, its translations, its installer. None of it is the type's.
